findings.message: GROUNDING CAVEAT: the daemon graph for this Story is hollow — the code-review grounding indexed only the diff of a pre-existing .insrc/artifacts/CR-*.json, not the actual src/mcp/schema/* + server.ts changes, so no symbol/test edges were available. Adherence was therefore judged by reading the diff directly + running the suite. Verdict: ADHERES. insrc_schema is read-only (readOnlyHint:true, no I/O, no mutation — k5); every failure returns a structured InsrcSchemaError, nothing throws (k3); the served JSON Schema is derived from the exact registered zod rawShape object (registerAndRecord stores config.inputSchema by reference — k1), via the SDK's own toJsonSchemaCompat (no cloud/REST path). No project-rule breach found.
